rows.label: P5 · PROPOSAL, not in the article · teaching card W-ISO
rows.text: Behavioral Warning (The Isolation Trap): This protocol demands starving your brain of "Phasic" Dopamine (excitement, novelty, the chase), and the easiest way to do that is to hole up alone. But do not isolate completely, because total social isolation spikes cortisol, the chronic stress hormone, and that sensitizes your brain to glutamate and locks the armor in place even if you've never had an addiction. You still need the "Oxytocinergic Anchoring" of having people around you, as long as it's the calm kind of company.
notes: Three tries by itself, each one window, AI High: [try 1](https://www.pangram.com/history/2bef0402-3916-4f9c-b1cd-2678afe1b0fd), [try 2](https://www.pangram.com/history/e4fe5ff4-a18f-4149-9012-602e43efe756), [try 3](https://www.pangram.com/history/11c50d40-e436-4393-be4f-522934cc9c33). The article keeps your post's paragraph until your version.
Leaves out "because humans are social animals"; adds that holing up alone is the easiest way to cut the dopamine.

notes: With the Cognitive Warning after it: [Human Written](https://www.pangram.com/history/d733d10c-8ca8-4761-8e03-4ad19be07015): its first sentence Medium, its second High. Not in until every window is High; next turn's small steps.

rows.label: P10 · PROPOSAL, not in the article · teaching card W-AGMINTRO
rows.text: Agmatine Warning (The Voltage Governor): Agmatine is optional in this protocol, and although it's sold as a supplement, it's a neuromodulator, here as a brake on NMDA/glutamate signaling. It can interact with a lot more medications than a basic nutrient like magnesium or a membrane nutrient like phosphatidylcholine would, since it also acts on imidazoline/alpha-2 adrenergic tone, nitric-oxide pathways, and opioid reward/tolerance.
notes: Three tries by itself, each one window, AI High: [try 1](https://www.pangram.com/history/61e59dc5-7acd-488f-be9d-6277cdbdc2d4), [try 2](https://www.pangram.com/history/08c6a4d2-9228-4ddd-a038-6988c2a72769), [try 3](https://www.pangram.com/history/2829fcb4-fcf2-4f52-b75d-70268695285b). rows.label: P13 · PROPOSAL, not in the article · teaching card W-HTPTOP
rows.text: Uridine & 5-HTP Warning for Psychedelic Users: These two supplements are in this protocol for repair, so don't use them as "trip enhancers." In practice they can quickly change how strongly psychedelics hit you, so don't count on your usual dose acting the way it used to. 5-HTP is also what your body makes serotonin out of, so taking it on top of anything else that raises serotonin is how people end up with serotonin syndrome, which can be deadly (see [the 5-HTP section](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/i/181671197/serotonin-bottleneck-pattern-5-htp-low-dose-p5p)). So never take it with any of these: SSRIs, SNRIs, MAOIs, linezolid, lithium, tramadol, methadone, fentanyl, DXM, MDMA, St. John's wort, SAM-e or L-tryptophan. Rule: psychedelics act on serotonin too, so do not take 5-HTP on the same day as a psychedelic trip, and do not use it anywhere near ayahuasca/harmalas or iboga, iboga microdoses included. That's because ayahuasca's harmalas inhibit MAO-A, which amplifies the serotonin load, while ibogaine and noribogaine interact with serotonin transport themselves, on top of the serious cardiac and neurological risk iboga already carries.
source: Rule: do not take 5-HTP on the same day as psychedelics
